decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot integrates the firm's core formwork, robotics and control knowledge, so its own R&D can keep interpreting field results and refining it.
Automatic de-shuttering builds directly on established precast automation expertise, though overlap with the combined robot makes it somewhat more exposed to portfolio consolidation.
Automatic shuttering is a central element of the firm's automated circulation plants, and its accumulated engineering knowledge lets it absorb customer feedback and improve the robot.
The recently launched multi-model cleaning and plotting line extends well-understood pallet-handling technology, giving the firm a strong knowledge base to develop it further.
Production analysis software leverages the firm's in-house control and planning software capabilities and supports learning from plant data across its installed base.
